title: Quiet Color Hunt
instruction: Can you find something this color at the table?

title: Fork Count
instruction: How many forks can you see? Count them softly together.

title: Round and Round
instruction: Find something shaped like a circle. Point without touching!

title: Tiny Detective
instruction: Find one thing that is shiny and one thing that is soft.

title: What Disappeared?
instruction: Look at three table items. Close your eyes while a grown-up hides one. What is missing?

title: Menu Letter Search
instruction: Can you find three words on the menu that start with the same letter?

title: Table Math
instruction: Count all the cups and plates. Which group has more?

title: Order Expert
instruction: Listen to everyone’s order. Can you remember who chose what?

title: Five Senses Spy
instruction: Name one thing you can see, hear, smell, touch, and taste.

title: Alphabet Table
instruction: Find table items whose names begin with F, C, and P.

title: Car Color Bingo
instruction: Which color car can you spot first?

title: Big Truck Count
instruction: Count five big trucks out the window. Tell me when you reach five!

title: Window Shapes
instruction: Can you spot a circle, a square, and a triangle outside?

title: Cloud Creatures
instruction: Look at the clouds. Does one look like an animal? What animal is it?

title: I Packed a Bag
instruction: Say one thing to pack. A grown-up adds one. Can you remember both?

title: Sign Letter Safari
instruction: Find the letters B, U, and G on signs outside.

title: Ten-Car Tally
instruction: Watch ten cars pass. How many are light colors and how many are dark?

title: What Changed?
instruction: Study the view for ten seconds. Close your eyes, then name three things you remember.

title: Silly Story Road
instruction: Make a tiny story using a car, a tree, and something you see outside.

title: Roadside Rainbow
instruction: Spot something outside for four different rainbow colors.

title: Produce Rainbow
instruction: Find a fruit or vegetable in each color.

title: Apple Counter
instruction: Help count four apples as they go into the bag.

title: Box or Can?
instruction: Find one box and one round can on the shelf.

title: Cold Food Finder
instruction: Point to three foods that need to stay cold.

title: Loud or Quiet?
instruction: Listen carefully. Name one loud sound and one quiet sound.

title: Aisle Alphabet
instruction: Find food labels beginning with A, B, and C.

title: Perfect Half Dozen
instruction: Choose six pieces of produce and count them into the bag.

title: Food Group Detective
instruction: Find one fruit, vegetable, grain, and dairy food.

title: Shopping List Star
instruction: Remember these three items: milk, bananas, and bread. Tell us when you spot each one.

title: Package Patterns
instruction: Find a package with stripes, one with spots, and one with a picture of an animal.
